items.title: Janas: Run LLMs larger than RAM by streaming experts from SSD
items.blurb: 37 tok/s from Qwen3-Next-80B (48 GB) on a 32 GB laptop, 24 without drafts vs 2.8 for llama.cpp; reading 62 vs 16 tok/s. Faster than llama.cpp on all 13 models compared in Q4_K_M. LLMs bigger than your RAM, pure C, CPU or GPU.

items.title: Production Patterns for Agents, Evals, and LLM Costs: QCon AI New York 2026
items.blurb: Once AI is in production, code arrives faster than it can be reviewed, token costs rise, evals have to be good enough to act on, and agents need permissions and guardrails.
